log_policy: Use synthetic or approved public inputs only. Do not place private data, bearer tokens, signed URLs, prompts, source passages, uploads, or provider credentials in logs, traces, screenshots, or artifacts.

cases.objective: Complete one citation-audited claim verification through report retrieval and SSE reconnect.
Verify public URL intake, retrieval safety, source snapshots, and inaccessible-source handling when applicable.
Verify pasted article text classification, decomposition, report synthesis, and durable provenance.
Verify attribution and quote-fidelity handling without treating the result as a speaker credibility score.
Verify paraphrase meaning comparison, evidence classification, deterministic scoring, and citation audit.
Verify private upload storage, document extraction, signed export download, and private bucket permissions.
